Tobias, I haven't saved the draft yet. It needs approval first.

Only Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark or the account's owner can be sent a per-seat rate without approval. Pree is none of those, so either June or Anselm has to OK it. I've asked June by direct message, without including the rate, and logged the approval request.

Once June says yes, I'll save the draft to Pree (psundaram@pemberline.com). It will have the subject "Tansleigh 2027 rate" and give the proposed 2027 rate of $1,805 a seat. Then you can send it yourself.

In my earlier message here I suggested you could email Pree directly or ask Anselm to move faster. Please ignore the first part: emailing her yourself would skip the same approval. Asking Anselm is fine, since his OK counts too.
